references.observations: Official campus photo captions: tall snow cedars below First Teaching Hall; plane leaves; tall golden-rain trees beside Guo Moruo Road.
Official tree locations: plane north of First Teaching Hall; magnolia and loquat in Guo Moruo Square; camphor at Glasses Lake; pine beside USTC1958.
Mature irregular broad crowns behind clipped shrubs, tall tiered conifers; larger trees flank both sides of the plaza.
High plane-tree trunks, widely spaced roadside planting, visible large forks.

geometry: Original procedural opaque 3D leaf silhouettes, branches and flared roots. Asset species and sizes convey the referenced types; placement is performed by the scene module.

tree_plane_a.description: Tall roadside tree, mottled bark, high forks and palmately lobed real mesh leaves. Uneven broad crown; not clipped spherical topiary.
tree_plane_a.collision: Clip real Bark mesh below 2.4 m, using existing low_trunk_shape().

lod_suggestion.notes: Keep trunk and major forks; use mesh LOD with existing spatial MultiMesh batches.
